problem_statement: When receiving a DNS/mDNS PTR response whose target name begins with an empty label (a single NUL byte followed by a service type name), the mDNS browser accepts the malformed record and invokes its browse callback with the empty service instance, instead of dropping it. The browser should reject PTR records whose first (service-instance) label is empty, report no browse result, and continue querying without adding a known-answer for the rejected record.
oracle_note: observed by validate_instance.py (fail before, pass after the fix); the unit oracle is per executable, so check attribution of the cases to the PR's change
